definitions_and_hypotheses_checked: M28 weak pinching is R >= -6 and R >= 2 nu (log nu - 3) for nu > 0. Its same-time and dense-time constants can differ; the universal accuracy can be common.

Dense-time order is every included s <= t, every a < s, some included a < u <= s, then every spatial point at u. Threshold is fixed at 4 times original base scalar. Rebasing at 2Q uses cutoff 8Q supplied by the stronger 4Q control.
Common blow-up controls use one analytic constant for both guarded bounds, compact terminal balls, terminal scale-bounded noncollapse and maximal worldline survival [-mu Q/max(Q,R),0].

Long source cylinders are open-left (-T,0] for each T<T0. Short conclusion uses a closed positive interval. Finite long limit is (-T0,0], not [-T0,0]. Every included slice, including zero, is complete.
Limit curvature bounds precede all spatial points on each compact time set. Geometric-only branch requires radius-independent slab bounds and terminal volume but asserts no ancient noncollapse.
Infinite-horizon ancient identification preserves carrier, metric and connection and does not require a classification input. The classification is used later in the horn argument.

Singular interval is exactly [0,T). Retained region is finite liminf on the fixed reference carrier. Analytic bounds hold at all old times above r0^-2; canonical hypotheses hold only at zero or nonsingular times.
cT = 10^14; standing datum has cT epsilon <= 1/200; output terminal control uses cT epsilon and 2C above the strict threshold R>r0^-2.
Terminal gluing domain is (tMinus,T] times terminal carrier. The empty region produces no included terminal time.

StrongHorn has no C parameter, has a proper actual S2 x [0,1) parameterization with collar, a boundary central sphere, and a terminal strong neck at every point. The defining neck carriers need not lie inside the horn.
M32 horn accuracy is cT epsilon, not 2 cT epsilon. h is chosen before all flows, supplied terminal conclusions and horns; boundary bound is (rho/(2C))^-2. Contained necks are asserted at R>=h^-2.

The selector works at every smaller positive height, including exact-level end cuts, and is independent of original canonical radius r0>rho. Restriction changes the threshold datum while retaining the same extension.
substantive_proof_mechanisms: Two rescalings in M28: first incomplete finite-diameter neck end, then actual ray scalar rescaling with 1/16 < R d^2 <= B and positive finite limiting ratio.
Local cone annulus gives a locally Lipschitz quadratic potential; uniform normal coordinates plus Rademacher give smoothness; homothetic gradient and terminal Ricci derivative energy force flatness.
Dense-time compact path transport uses one common good slice and scalar rebasing at 2Q with radius (A+1)sqrt(2), D0/2 and max(4,2D).
M30 common short interval follows only after global boundedness of the complete static terminal limit; local finite backward flows suffice for the nullity branch.

M30 finite endpoint proof combines Harnack, integrable square-root distance distortion, bounded-distance propagation, opposite neck exits and impossibility of point separation, then complete endpoint extension and cofinal horizons.

M31 entire-family jet convergence is obtained by integrating bounded jets of Ricci, not merely by selecting a subsequential tensor; properness uses backward scalar and spatial estimates in compact reference carrier.
M31 same-core cap uses translated shortened end with shift -L+r, negative-quarter endpoint -L+r/2, terminal scalar normalization, coefficient 3/(4C) and budget 32+6(2000000000004)^2 < cT^2.

M32 compact separator forces compact factor by a three-segment detour; ordered real fiber heights force a neck sphere to be a single graph; compact graph-frontier obstruction rules out both cap models.
M32 scalar sign comes from |Delta R| <= R^2/6 and |Ric|^2 >= R^2/3. Regular-time sign and continuity cross exceptional times before actual cylinders extend by a fixed step.
Arbitrary-subsequence criterion yields eventual stage cylinders on the original sequence. Same-worldline equality transfers the common all-time scalar bound to the retained ancient limit.
A compact low prefix gives a seed cut; the last prescribed-level crossing gives a connected high-scalar set; compactly supported sphere transport propagates the cut without continuous neck choices.
Buffered smaller-height construction precedes radius restriction and finite dyadic prefix minima; least eligible index is essential.
